props.text: Still waiting for this particular short on $BTC. Ideally, I want to see a sweep above the external highs. The only issue is we're currently struggling to flip 65.6K. If we can break above it, there's a good chance we get that sweep.

This is a conditional setup—waiting for 65.6K break to add to his existing scalp-short hedge (entered 64.8–65.8K ladder 07-14). Aligns with HTF long conviction (2x @62.6K) as a controlled tactical hedge.
